limitations: All 64,572,998 source records passed exact independent source comparison and a byte-identical clean analytical rebuild. Local analytical and display packages are prepared; public hosting has not been tested.
Raw observations are separate source records and short parts, not a connected river centerline network. Records are never joined by segmentID or segmentInd.
width_m value 1 is an unknown-width sentinel; width_valid indicates usable width without altering width_m.

PMTiles is a quantized display derivative: zooms 0–7 contain coverage cells without feature identities or measured widths; zooms 8–12 contain detailed observations. The 304 enumerated r1 fragments of 0.0013–2.93 m that collapse to tile-grid points remain unchanged, with no new detail omissions. All are preserved in analytical GeoParquet.
The release excludes masks, tile index, and RSSA basin supplement.
No GEE parity, global independent scientific-accuracy assessment, current-condition claim, or producer-operation reconstruction is made.

All detailed tile coordinates, IDs, integer geometry commands, typed widths and multiplicity exactly match r1 across all 588,355 tiles and 345,749,975 occurrences. The retained r1 source-geometry controls are sampled. Coverage encoding is checked completely, with independent source controls covering 1,158,798 observations. Eleven detail cases, five multiscale cases and three camera-switch checkpoints test local browser behavior; public hosting and global scientific accuracy are not established.

product_metadata.summary: Complete GRWL V01.01 raw vector observations in lossless GeoParquet, with one separately versioned zoom 0–12 PMTiles display. Zooms 0–7 show observation coverage; zooms 8–12 preserve detailed source identities, geometry and local widths. All 64,572,998 observations and ten original DBF fields remain in GeoParquet. Complete source comparison, analytical rebuild, global display checks, clean regional replay and browser checks passed. These are local prepared releases; no product has been created or uploaded.
product_metadata.temporal_note: Static producer release derived from Landsat observations with varying source dates; not current river conditions or a time series.
